description: MACS's own test data: reads of a ChIP-seq of CTCF and of its control (input), on human chromosome 22 (hg19 positions) – single-end reads as BED, and the same experiment's paired-end fragments as MACS's three-column BEDPE – and the peaks that MACS's test of callpeak expects. Unchanged, under their own names.

source.licence: BSD-3-Clause (the repository; its test data has no licence of its own) – LICENSE.MACS3

test: test/cmdlinetest of the repository: macs3 callpeak -g 52000000 -t CTCF_SE_ChIP_chr22_50k.bed.gz -c CTCF_SE_CTRL_chr22_50k.bed.gz -n run_callpeak_narrow0 -B --outdir … --cutoff-analysis; its expected peaks are run_callpeak_narrow0_peaks.narrowPeak (--cutoff-analysis does not change the peaks)
also: genomics-wasm (https://github.com/comparativechrono/genomics-wasm, commit c977980) uses the same files, under the names chip.bed.gz, control.bed.gz, chip.bedpe.gz, control.bedpe.gz and upstream-peaks.narrowPeak (datasets/macs3/), with the same SHA-256

CTCF_SE_ChIP_chr22_50k.bed.gz.change: none: the file as it is in the repository

CTCF_SE_CTRL_chr22_50k.bed.gz.change: none: the file as it is in the repository
